affectedRepoFiles: registry/untitledui/components/application/date-picker/date-picker.tsx (AriaDatePicker, AriaDialog, AriaGroup, AriaPopover, useDateFormatter, useControlledState from @react-stately/utils, getLocalTimeZone/today, DateValue)
consequence: NO_BASE_UI_EQUIVALENT. The wrapper (popover + dialog + trigger) could be rebuilt on Base UI Dialog/Popover/Button today, but the field and calendar it hosts cannot — so the component as a whole stays on React Aria.
notableDifferences: React Aria's DatePicker is a single component that bundles field + trigger + popover + calendar; Base UI has no such composition because the field/calendar layers are missing. A partial migration (popover/dialog only) would leave two competing interaction systems in one component — not recommended.
`useDateFormatter` (react-aria) for locale-aware display strings has no Base UI equivalent; Intl.DateTimeFormat must be used directly if any migration happens later.
